title: Region pin cost reconciliation & billing playbook
content:
Purpose
----
Working playbook for reconciling the incremental cost impact of region pins and translating that to customer billing, credits, and internal chargebacks. Focus: Dedicated + Private tenants where pinning forces capacity reservation, multi-cloud replication, or regional egress fees.

Scope (what's in/out)
----
In scope:
- Monthly cost delta computation for pinned tenants (reserved capacity, local storage, cross-region replication egress, KMS region usage).
- Mapping cost delta to invoice line items and/or SLA credits.
- Short-term (monthly) reconciliation and long-term amortization guidance for multi-month commitments.

Out of scope:
- Hosted/ephemeral tenant cases where pinning is transient (<24h) — handled by fallback playbook.
- Legal contract drafting (legal will sign off on templates).

Quick rationale / operating constraints
----
- Pinning can increase unit costs dramatically when we must spare dedicated GPUs in low-util regions or set up regional storage with higher unit prices. Customers reasonably expect predictable pricing; finance needs a repeatable reconciliation flow.
- Ops must be able to generate an "evidence bundle" showing why additional charges/credits occurred (telemetry + provisioning events).

Stakeholders
----
- Engineering-private-deployments: telemetry & provisioning mapping (owner: Priya)
- Finance / Billing: final invoice adjustments (owner: Carlos)
- Customer Success / AE: customer comms & negotiation (owner: Maya)
- Legal: approve contract language and credits

Assumptions
----
- We have per-tenant tagged telemetry for: region_pin_active (bool), pinned_region (string), region_capacity_reservations (list), provision_events (timestamps).
- Cost model components are available monthly from infra-finance: GPU-hours-by-region, storage-by-region, egress-by-region, reserved-instance amortization.
- There is a canonical cost baseline per tenant (pre-pin average monthly spend) stored in billing_system.baselines.

Signals and data sources (how to prove cost delta)
----
- Telemetry tables (examples):
  - residency.telemetry_pin_events: (tenant_id, event_type, timestamp, region, event_id)
  - infra.provisioning_allocs: (alloc_id, tenant_id, region, instance_type, start_ts, end_ts, cost_estimate)
  - billing.usage_raw: (tenant_id, month, region, resource_type, units, cost_usd)
  - metrics.edge_egress: (region_from, region_to, tenant_id, bytes, cost_usd)

- Evidence bundle to attach to customer story:
  - sliced billing.usage_raw for months T-2..T (pre/post pin)
  - provision_events timeline showing reserved capacity start
  - tracing snippet showing routed requests pinned to region (for performance justification)
  - CFO-signed cost-allocation memo if cross-charging occurs

Computation method (step-by-step)
----
1) Establish baseline: median monthly cost for last 3 months (exclude top/bottom 5% outliers). Query: SELECT median(cost_usd) FROM billing.usage_raw WHERE tenant_id=@tenant AND month in (T-3..T-1)
2) Compute post-pin cost: sum(cost_usd) for months after pin active
3) Delta = post-pin cost - baseline (if negative, mark note: pin reduced cost)
4) Decompose delta by category: GPU, storage, egress, kms, support
5) Attribute to driver: either (a) mandatory pin cost (we must charge), (b) soft cost (we absorb/credit), or (c) pass-through (e.g., third-party egress) — see attribution rules below.

Attribution rules (first pass)
----
- Mandatory pin cost: additional dedicated GPU hours for pinned region when utilization > 0.5 or reserved instances purchased.
- Support premium: if pin required dev time above 10 engineer-hours billed to customer per contract clause.
- Pass-through: third-party managed storage/egress (show vendor invoice).
- Opt-in discounts: enterprise customers with committed reserved capacity get a negotiated cap; compute deltas beyond cap as billable.

Invoice mapping and line items
----
Use explicit, human-readable invoice lines (examples):
- "Region Pin Premium — eu-west-1 — reserved GPU amortization" (USD 1,200)
- "Regional storage mirror — eu-west-1 (30d)" (USD 240)
- "Cross-region egress (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1)" (USD 93)
- "Implementation support (engineering) — 12h @ 175/h — one-time"

Credits and SLA adjustments
----
- If pinning failed and caused availability loss, SLA credit calculated from agreed SLA table. Credits are separate from pin cost reconciliation (finance treats as negative line on next invoice).
- For early termination of pin (customer requested), offer pro-rated credit for unused reserved capacity when contract allows.

Internal chargeback and amortization
----
- If pinning caused infra team to purchase long-term reserved capacity, amortize cost across affected customers over the reservation term. Record in finance.reservation_amortization with fields: reservation_id, total_cost, affected_tenant_ids (list), amort_months.
- For small customers (< $X/month baseline) we may choose to absorb first-month spike as part of sales onboarding budget (owner: GTM Ops).

Customer communication templates (short examples)
----
Subject: Region pin cost impact for [tenant-name]
Body (short):
Hi [Name],
Following our region pin for [eu-west-1] on [2025-01-05], attached is a short summary of the additional operational cost for this month and how it will appear on your next invoice. We include the evidence bundle (telemetry + provisioning events). If you'd prefer to cap monthly pin costs we can discuss a 1/3 month reservation or alternative routing mix.

Operational run (monthly cadence)
----
- Day 1-5: Ops generates monthly reconciliation report for pinned tenants (script: infra/reports/pin-reconcile-monthly).
- Day 6-10: Finance reviews and approves proposed invoice adjustments.
- Day 11-12: CS notifies customer with proposed charges and evidence bundle (template above).
- Day 13-20: Customer negotiation window; final invoice scheduled for Day 25.

Automated tooling checklist (TODOs for eng)
----
- [ ] Build pin-cost-collector (ETL) to join telemetry + provision events + raw usage into single view (target: month-over-month deltas).
- [ ] Add "pin_reason" tag to infra.provisioning_allocs to make attribution deterministic.
- [ ] Implement evidence-bundle generator (zip of queries + CSVs + signed policy note).
- [ ] Add a finance dashboard (Looker) showing top 50 tenants by pin delta.

Sample queries / pseudo-SQL
----
-- baseline
SELECT tenant_id, APPROX_QUANTILE(cost_usd, 0.5) as median_cost FROM billing.usage_raw WHERE tenant_id = 'T-123' AND month BETWEEN '2024-10' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY tenant_id;

-- delta by region
SELECT month, region, SUM(cost_usd) as cost FROM billing.usage_raw WHERE tenant_id='T-123' AND month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-02' GROUP BY month, region ORDER BY month;

Open questions & risks (needs decisions)
----
- Risk: We may be double-billing when reserved capacity covers multiple tenants but provisioning records attribute to "pool". Decision: require alloc tagging policy by Feb-20.
- Question: Should small SMB customers be auto-exempt from pin charges for first 90 days? Finance needs a threshold and approval flow.
- Risk: Legal may require separate consent for pass-through vendor charges — confirm with Legal.

Action items (owners + ETA)
----
- Priya: prototype pin-cost-collector ETL + sample evidence bundle (ETA: 2025-02-10)
- Carlos: draft invoice line taxonomy and sample invoice PDF (ETA: 2025-02-14)
- Maya: customer-facing email + negotiation SLA draft (ETA: 2025-02-14)
- Legal: review templates and pass-through clause (ETA: 2025-02-21)

Notes / historical context
----
- Internal pilot in Q4 2024 with three EU customers showed average monthly delta of $1.9k per tenant driven by reserved GPUs and storage mirrors. Lessons: need clearer attribution and earlier CS communication.

Appendix: minimal evidence checklist (what to attach)
----
1) billing.usage_raw slice (CSV) T-2..T+0
2) infra.provisioning_allocs entries (CSV) showing reservation start/end
3) vendor invoices for pass-through third-party costs if any
4) short operations timeline (README.txt) explaining key events

(End of doc)
